description: Animate or set light properties in the active scene

SetIntensity.description: Set or animate the intensity of a light component. With duration_seconds > 0 the value tweens using cubic ease-out; completion commits one undoable SetProperty command. A second call mid-tween preempts, starting from the current interpolated value.

assetId.description: UUID of the asset (scene) containing the light

duration_seconds.description: Tween duration in seconds. 0 = immediate commit.
